reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper does not report any insecticide-resistance marker genotyping (e.g., kdr, ace-1, etc.). It is a bioassay study on the effect of cattle-administered endectocides on mosquito mortality and fecundity.

african_field_population.evidence: The mosquitoes used were laboratory-reared colonies obtained from the Vector Control Laboratory of the South African National Institute for Communicable Diseases.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study investigating the effects of ivermectin and fipronil on An. arabiensis.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted at the Experimental farm of the University of Pretoria, Pretoria, South Africa.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was published in 2021 and the experiments were conducted within a single study period.

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a new experimental study using laboratory-reared mosquitoes.

supplement.evidence: No genotype data is required as the paper does not report any.

assessment.summary: This study investigated the effect of cattle-administered ivermectin and fipronil on the mortality and fecundity of laboratory-reared Anopheles arabiensis. It did not perform any insecticide-resistance marker genotyping.
